title: Career Roadmap: Fab Engineer
summary: Career Domain: Engineering, Technology & Computing · Qualification Pathway: B.Tech / B.E. – Semiconductor Technology / VLSI Design & Technology · Target Career: Fab Engineer

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Fab Engineer keeps a semiconductor fabrication line running: the process steps (lithography, etch, deposition, implant, CMP) that turn silicon wafers into chips, with high yield and tight control. India's new fabs and the India Semiconductor Mission are creating these roles at home for the first time.

items.text: Monitor and tune one or more process steps so wafers stay within specification
Analyse yield and defect data and find the root cause of excursions
Run equipment qualifications, recipes and preventive-maintenance checks with vendors
Write process documentation and work to cleanroom, safety and contamination rules
Semiconductor fabs and pilot lines (e.g. Tata Electronics Dholera, SCL Mohali)
Assembly, test and packaging (ATMP/OSAT) plants
Equipment and materials suppliers
Government and university nanofabrication centres

blocks.text: Year 1: Physics, chemistry and electronics foundations

items.text: Master semiconductor physics basics: band theory, doping, p-n junctions
Learn Python or MATLAB for data handling
Read about how a chip is made, step by step
Study MOSFETs, CMOS and process flows (oxidation, lithography, etch, deposition)
Learn statistics and statistical process control (SPC)
Visit or take an online lab course at a nanofabrication facility
Do a project on yield, defect analysis or a simulated process flow (TCAD)
Learn design of experiments (DoE) and Six Sigma basics
Intern at a fab, OSAT or equipment company
Pick a module (litho, etch, thin film, metrology) and go deep
Final-year project with measurable process data
Prepare for campus hiring and GATE if you want an M.Tech
JMP or Minitab
Python (pandas)
TCAD process simulators
SPC/MES dashboards
Metrology tools (SEM, ellipsometer)
Fab, ATMP or OSAT plants
Semiconductor equipment and gas/chemical suppliers
IIT/IISc nanofabrication centres (summer research)
Six Sigma Green Belt
Courses under the India Semiconductor Mission / C2S programme
Online courses in semiconductor manufacturing (NPTEL)

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.

items.text: M.Tech Microelectronics / VLSI / Nanotechnology
MS in Electrical or Materials Engineering abroad

blocks.text: Entrance exams and tests to know:

items.text: GATE (EC/EE/PH/MT)
MS in Taiwan, Singapore, South Korea, the US or Europe, where most fabs are
Fab roles in those countries after the MS

blocks.text: Roles a Fab Engineer can grow into or move across to:

items.text: Process Integration Engineer
Yield Engineer
Equipment Engineer
Metrology Engineer
